headline: Neon announces open-source SCP Foundation film after A24 backlash
summary: Neon announced it will make an SCP Foundation movie released under a Creative Commons license, positioning itself against A24, whose earlier SCP film project angered the horror community by reportedly skipping required licensing and community contact.

claims.statement: Neon announced it will make an SCP Foundation movie released under a Creative Commons license, after A24's earlier SCP film project drew community backlash.

sources.quote: Neon sticks it to A24 by announcing a Creative Commons SCP Foundation movie
Neon will make a truly open-source SCP movie after A24 controversy

A24 pissed off one of the internet's largest horror communities when it announced it was working on an SCP Foundation film, but apparently hadn't bothered to contact the SCP Wiki team, nor did it commit to releasing it under a Creative Commons license as required
